aspect: The scam association poisons the ordinary approach
description: Because the best-known Nigerian presence in online dating is fraudulent, a genuine Nigerian man making a genuine approach is met with a suspicion specific to his nationality. The irony recorded in REP-001 applies: the actual scammers are posing as white Americans.
energy_note: He is real, and the fake ones have made that the hard part.

aspect: Being used and discarded is a real pattern
description: Relationships in which the Nigerian partner is a novelty, a project, or a story rather than a person - warm, intense, and ended once the cost of association becomes concrete. The harm is that the interest was never in the person.
energy_note: Fascinating for a season, and then inconvenient.

description: A relationship between a Nigerian and a citizen of a wealthier country is assessed by friends, family and the state as a possible immigration route, so the couple must prove sincerity to people who did not ask to be involved.
money_note: Cost of evidencing a genuine relationship to an immigration authority.
energy_note: Proving you are in love, to a government, in writing.

aspect: At home the market is shaped by the economics
description: Marriage expectations attach to a man's earning capacity in an economy described in ECO-001, and to a woman's age and family standing - so both sides are assessed against criteria that the rest of this dataset makes harder to meet.
energy_note: Judged on a salary the currency keeps shrinking.

aspect: Widowhood and divorce reprice a woman entirely
description: The widow in WOM-005 and the divorced woman face a narrowed market, custody consequences and a social status that is assigned rather than chosen.
energy_note: Re-sorted, by an event she did not cause.

aspect: And isolation removes the thing that buffers everything else
description: Partnership is the largest single protective factor against every stressor in this dataset. A market distorted by stereotype, documents and economics removes it from the people carrying the most.
energy_note: The main shock absorber, priced out of reach.

description: It is going well. She asks, lightly, what he does, and he says he works in crypto compliance, which is true. There is a pause that is a quarter-second too long. He has learned to hear that pause and he hears it now.
energy_note: A true answer, and the quarter-second after it.
